name: doklado-mcp
description: Unofficial Doklado connector: invoices, PDFs and Slovak eFaktúra (Peppol) for Claude.
long_description: Unofficial community extension, not made or supported by Doklado s.r.o. Find and update invoices, download PDFs, email invoices, and send or receive eFaktúra over Peppol through your Doklado account. eFaktúra tools appear when SAPI+ credentials are filled in.

ico.title: IČO
ico.description: IČO of your company in Doklado

sandbox.title: Test mode (Doklado sandbox)
sandbox.description: Use the test account at efaktura-sandbox.doklado.sk instead of your real Doklado. The keys must come from the same place.

allow_issue.title: Allow issuing invoices
allow_issue.description: Lets Claude create new invoices. Needs the module "Vystavenie faktúr cez API" turned on in Doklado (Správa modulov).

sapi_secret.title: SAPI+ Client Secret (optional, for eFaktúra)
sapi_secret.description: Shown once when the SAPI+ connection is created

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List invoices and receipts with filters

tools.name: get_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Save the invoice PDF to Downloads

tools.name: einvoice_lookup
tools.description: Can a company receive eFaktúra (by DIČ)

tools.name: einvoice_get_received
tools.description: Save a received eFaktúra XML to Downloads

tools.name: einvoice_acknowledge
tools.description: Mark a received eFaktúra as processed
